notes.title: Version 0.99 patch 11
notes.notes:
/********************** version 0.99 patch 11 ************************/  
1. Fixed an issue where HQ status was not showing correctly with the mouse over.

2. If you select a skin that is not downloaded it will immediately download when selected in the hangar.

3. Added a on screen text message when the auto change country changed your country.

4. Arena Reboots and terrain changes now will have your client exit to the arena selection menu.

********************** WOP version 0.99 patch 2 ************************/
1. Fixed a bug where Environment mapping would click off under certian views.

2. Fixed a bug causing icons not to disappear in clouds.

3. Changed the look of the battle and plane selection GUI.

4. Added a new kill race game type.

notes.title: Version 0.99 Patch 1
notes.notes:
/********************** version 0.99 patch 1 ************************/
1. Fixed an issue with damage of controls not working correctly.

2, Added a "Show All Control Keys" button to both In Flight and On Ground GUI's.

3. Added about 120 new Controller configuration files.

4. Made a small change that increased FPS when the GUI was open. Went from about 45 fps to 110 fps on a GForce 980 TI.

5. The lead computing cross hairs now change color based on approximate range, and also will not auto lock until 1800 yards

notes.title: New Release date.
notes.notes: Our current target date is for Jan 15. If you wish to be involved in the beta you can download WOP now at https://www.waronline.com
